Anonymous visitors can read. They cannot edit.

Logged-in accounts (same swccg.com identity when SSO is wired; local password until then) may '''suggest''' a revision. Suggestions are not public until a trusted editor accepts them (FlaggedRevs).

Trusted editors: appointed by the owner, or earned after 10 accepted pending revisions with no spam-class rejects.

Do not paste unverified card text into gold sections. Cite a source or mark <code>needs_source</code>.
